units.task:
Build the command menu (SPEC §4 'Command menu' bullet) as src/commandMenu.ts implementing S2, styled in src/styles/menu.css, tested in src/commandMenu.test.ts.
Read first: CLAUDE.md (guardrails 13, conventions), SPEC.md §4, src/infobar.ts and its test (how showInfo, body, key, onClose, Esc and focus return work), src/types.ts InfoMessage, src/commands.ts, src/platform.ts keys(), src/dom.ts (plainField, button), src/editor/search.ts keepFocus (mousedown preventDefault pattern), src/styles/main.css (.infobar and .firstsave-* rules, tokens).
Behaviour:
- toggleCommandMenu: when the 'command-menu' bar is shown, clear it; else showInfo({ kind: 'info', key: 'command-menu', text: '', body }) with body = a filter <input> (plainField, aria-label 'Command', placeholder 'Type a command') and a list (role=listbox; rows role=option with aria-selected; a toggle row also aria-checked and a check mark; each row shows c.keys through keys()). Focus the field on open.
- Filter: every whitespace-separated word of the field must be a substring of the title, case-insensitive. Rows keep `source()` order. At most 6 rows visible; the list scrolls and keeps the selected row in view.
- ArrowUp/ArrowDown move the selection (clamped at the ends); Enter runs the selected row. A command row: clear the bar first, then run(id). A toggle row (has `checked`): run(id), keep the menu open, rebuild the rows from source() keeping filter text and selection, so the check mark shows the new state.
- Mouse: mousedown on a row is prevented (focus stays in the field); click runs the row as Enter would.
- Esc closes through the info bar's own handling; do not add a second Esc path. Ctrl+Shift+P while open closes (that is the toggle; app.ts calls it).
- menu.css: only existing tokens (--info-bg, --line, --hover, --pressed, --text, --text-muted, --accent, --focus); the selected row uses --hover; hide the bar's empty text span for this bar only (for example .infobar:has(.cmdmenu) .infobar-text { display: none }). No new colour tokens. Rows ~28px, the app's UI font size.
Tests (jsdom, mount the real info bar as infobar.test.ts does): toggle opens and closes; typing filters with two words; arrows + Enter run a command once and the bar is gone; a toggle keeps the bar open and its row's aria-checked flips; mousedown on a row is defaultPrevented and click runs it; Esc removes the bar.
units.output: The three files. Handoff: proves lists what each test shows.

checks.proves: menu opens, filters, runs commands and toggles as SPEC §4 says

1. CODE_LANGUAGES: LanguageDescription.of({ name, alias, load }) for JavaScript (js, jsx, mjs, cjs), TypeScript (ts, tsx), JSON, CSS, HTML (htm), Python (py), Rust (rs), SQL, Shell (sh, bash, zsh, shell; @codemirror/legacy-modes/mode/shell through StreamLanguage.define), YAML (yml). Every load is a dynamic import(); no static import of any language package anywhere, so none lands in the startup chunk (SPEC §9).
2. codeParser(info): matchLanguageName(CODE_LANGUAGES, info, true); null when none; the loaded language's parser when desc.support is set; otherwise ParseContext.getSkippingParser(desc.load()), as lang-markdown does.
3. setup.ts: the markdown LanguageSupport uses a Language that SHARES markdownLanguage.data and parses with markdownLanguage.parser.configure(parseCode({ codeParser })) (parseCode from @lezer/markdown). CRITICAL: list keys (src/editor/lists.ts and CodeMirror's insertNewlineContinueMarkup/deleteMarkupBackward) call markdownLanguage.isActiveAt, which compares the language-data facet; a Language with different data silently turns list keys off. Keep the existing HighlightStyle and add syntaxHighlighting(classHighlighter) so code tokens carry tok-* classes. Keep GFM and pasteURLAsLink, and do not call markdown() (it pulls lang-html into startup).
4. highlightCode(target, code, info): find the description, await desc.load() (a failure resolves false), parse code with its language's parser, emit spans with className from classHighlighter and textContent only (never innerHTML), plain text nodes between; replace target's children only on success; resolve true.
5. code.css: colour tok-keyword, tok-string/tok-string2, tok-comment, tok-number/tok-bool/tok-atom, tok-typeName/tok-className/tok-namespace with var(--tok-keyword|--tok-string|--tok-comment|--tok-number|--tok-type), only inside code: the editor's fenced-code lines (see mdStyle.ts for their class) and read mode's `.read-view pre code`. Markdown's own marks (tok-meta, tok-punctuation, tok-heading, tok-emphasis ...) keep their current look.
Tests: unknown name gives null and highlightCode false with target unchanged; aliases resolve (py, rs, sh, yml); highlightCode on `const x = 1` (js) produces a .tok-keyword span whose text is `const`, and target.textContent equals the input; an editor state with a ```js block, after the language loads and the tree is complete, has a tok-keyword token in the block (use ensureSyntaxTree and highlightTree or the view's DOM); src/editor/lists.test.ts still passes with the new setup (run it).
